expectation: Cytoplasmic microtubules. Pan-beta-tubulin labels most cells' cytoplasm, strongest in cells rich in microtubules: neurons and nerve fibres (enteric plexus), smooth muscle and fibroblast processes. I would expect fibrous networks rather than nuclei, organised by tissue layer.
observed: A: strong fibrous yellow confined to the outer muscular wall layer of each section, with radial fibre bands; mucosa dim. Background haze and a square tile glow. B and C: dim cytoplasm in the epithelium. D: bright branching fibres.
why: The signal is confined to one tissue compartment (the muscular wall) and has a fibrous, branching shape that fits microtubule-rich fibres; it does not follow cell density.
notes: Bright, fibrous beta-tubulin in the outer muscular layer only, with branching fibres at the cellular scale; the mucosa is dim. There is a diffuse haze off the tissue and a rectangular tile artefact, but they do not explain the layer-specific fibres.
